FBI Adds Goldy Brar to Ten Most Wanted List, Offers $1 Million Reward

The U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has added gangster Goldy Brar to its Ten Most Wanted Fugitives list. The FBI is offering a reward of up to $1 million for information leading to Brar's arrest. Brar is allegedly involved in the assassinations of political and religious figures. He is described as a fugitive associated with the Bishnoi gang.
